scope: Source audit of canonical shared geometry and split HG, not a multi-rank validation

findings.evidence: Arrays keyed by persistent PINDX; populated from local stage geometry; reciprocal neighbor face geometry is read by ID and periodic separation. Out-of-cap neighbor returns own length; missing reciprocal in-cap face returns zero.
findings.required: Exchange current-stage reciprocal face records with persistent ID plus periodic-image separation; invalidate old records after migration; missing data must not silently become vacuum.

findings.evidence: hg_ptr maps persistent IDs only to local owned VORO_NP particles. Every mode needs direct pointers to all support cells and its thermal owner.
findings.required: Explicit ownership and current state for full support, including multi-hop neighbors; apply each mode exactly once and return velocity/internal-energy updates to owners.

findings.evidence: Modes sorted by key and applied forward then reverse, modifying velocities in place. Modes sharing support generally do not commute.
findings.required: Preserve canonical global order for reference MPI implementation; any reordered/color-based parallel schedule is an integrator change requiring separate convergence and long-time validation.

findings.evidence: Stage callback migrates particles; wrapper snapshots local bytes and rejects changed local particle count. It is protected by MPI1 guard.
findings.required: Global accept/reject and timestep minimum; rollback ownership, stage arrays and auxiliary state consistently across migration, using persistent IDs.

findings.evidence: MPI reductions exist, but canonical multi-rank execution is prohibited upstream.
findings.required: Owned cells counted once; frozen boundary work accounted for; reduction existence is not evidence of MPI correctness.

implementation_order: Define and test stage-stamped face/particle records and ownership map on a static canonical snapshot with a partition cutting the inner edge.
Compare reciprocal geometry and force contributions at 1/2/4 ranks before evolution.
Provide ordered distributed HG reference preserving one-rank mode order and owner heat, then compare one split step.
Implement collective rollback across migration and validate forced rejection.
Run same canonical IC through t6-10 and long t20 target on 1/2/4 ranks.
Only after matching equations implement/validate CUDA TCF and accelerated HG scheduling.
constraints: Keep MPI guards until the needed communications and rollback exist.
No steering, preserve canonical IC and fixed masses.
Do not replace the production algorithm with a gather-to-root full solver and call it distributed coverage.
unresolved: Scalable ordered HG scheduling and its communication cost.
Completeness of multi-hop geometry under existing padding.
Long-time physical instability in current single-rank model.
